text_block_list.text: The day of the first Classic race, the Satsuki Sho—
...For some reason, Gold Ship was on a rampage!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Why...?!?! Why did it turn out like this?!?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Today's race...
Is the... "Satsuki Sho"... you say!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What the hell is this?! It's held in April,
so why the heck is it called "Satsuki"?!*
"Satsuki" means May in the lunar calendar, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit!! Dammit...!!
How dare you ignore April...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I just feel bad for April!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Can't just stand around! I'm gonna win today no matter what, all for the sake of April!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win this race—
and turn it into the "Uzuki Sho"!!!!

Before I could explain that the Satsuki Sho
was originally held in May,
Gold Ship had already wandered off...

For now, she seems to have plenty of fighting spirit,
so the race should be promising... hopefully!
